title: Master of Angels
problem: Master of Angels: copies Black Hole Halo's Scorned onto your Angels' attacks (code applied Bomb)

release_notes.intended: Your Angels' attacks apply the debuffs your other Angels' innate traits apply.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, for Black Hole Halo, the game applied Bomb instead of Scorned.
release_notes.fix: Now Black Hole Halo's Scorned is copied.
